title: Peblar x Enode: Expanding EV charger choices for energy retailers
summary: Across the Netherlands, electric vehicle (EV) adoption is moving from early growth to mainstream. For energy retailers, that shift is changing what customers expect from their energy provider. What began as EV-specific tariffs is evolving into offers that include a home charger, app-based smart charging, and flexibility programs designed to optimize renewable energy use and support grid stability. Now, EV charging optimization is becoming part of the core energy proposition, not an add-on. As expectations rise, EV charging needs to be reliable, easy to manage in the same app customers already use for their energy management, and delivered as part of a cohesive customer experience. That is why we are partnering with Peblar.
